Contest-optimized ON4KST chat for VHF, UHF and SHF operators.

KST4Contest is built for serious ham radio contest operation: priority candidates, AirScout integration, sked reminders, band detection, frequency detection, dual chat categories and workflow support for modern VHF/UHF/SHF contest stations.

Download releases View on GitHub

Built for contests

Unlike generic ON4KST clients, KST4Contest focuses on contest workflow, skeds, priorities and fast operator decisions.

Priority candidates

Score-based candidate ranking helps operators identify promising stations faster.

AirScout workflow

Airplane scatter windows and candidate timing can be integrated into the operating workflow.

Cross-platform releases

Windows, Linux and macOS builds are published through GitHub releases.
